name: Hannah Hart
milestone_by_age_26: Hart launched My Drunk Kitchen on YouTube in March 2011 (age 24), which gathered 800K views by July 2011 and grew to 2.3M+ subscribers by June 2015; she won a Streamy Award for Best Female Performance in a Comedy in 2013 (age 26).
early_history_summary: Hart was born and raised in the San Francisco Bay Area. Her parents separated when she was an infant, and she was raised by her mother who suffered from psychosis. She graduated from UC Berkeley in May 2009 with degrees in English literature and Japanese linguistics, then moved to Brooklyn to work as a proofreader for a Manhattan translating firm. In March 2011, she recorded herself drinking wine and attempting to make a grilled cheese sandwich, uploaded it as My Drunk Kitchen, and it went viral, leading her to quit her job within two months.
family_context_summary: Born and raised in the San Francisco Bay Area. Parents separated when she was an infant; raised by her mother who suffered from psychosis. She has a sister. The family financial situation was likely challenging given the mother's mental health condition.
